onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

correct.Description: whether trial was correct or not

delay_location.Description: y-position on track where delay occurred

update_location.Description: y-position on track where update occurred

delay2_location.Description: y-position on track where delay 2 occurred

behavior_task.Description: indicates whether VR task was displayed on the screen (1), or if the screen was left covered/blank as a baseline period (0)

recording_number.Description: what the original recording file number this epoch was (as saved in theraw spikegadgets and .mat file names), 1-based indexing

start_ind.Description: index of start time in lfp timeseries

stop_ind.Description: index of stop time in lfp timeseries

mid_ind.Description: index of middle time in lfp timeseries

energy.Description: total sum squared energy of the waveform

max_thresh.Description: the largest threshold in stdev units at which this ripple would be detected

threshold.Description: baseline value with X number of std above the mean for event detection

std.Description: standard deviation value used to generate threshold value

min_duration.Description: time (in seconds) signal must be above threshold for event detection

excluded.Description: any post-event detection exclusion criteria applied

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.update: The 'update' table in the NWB file.
Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.trial: The 'trial' table in the NWB file.
Levels.sync: The 'sync' table in the NWB file.
Levels.recording_epochs: The 'recording_epochs' table in the NWB file.
Levels.delay: The 'delay' table in the NWB file.
Levels.behavior_epochs: The 'behavior_epochs' table in the NWB file.
Levels.thetas: The 'thetas' table in the NWB file.
Levels.ripples: The 'ripples' table in the NWB file.
Levels.nonthetas: The 'nonthetas' table in the NWB file.

update.Description: indicates when the update cue is on or not, from spikegadgets digital signals

trial.Description: indicates when trial is occurring vs inter trial, from spikegadgets digital signals

sync.Description: synchronizing pulse sent from virmen software, from spikegadgets digital signals

recording_epochs.Description: During one recording session, the acquisition is stopped and restarted for switching behavioral periods, refilling with saline, etc. Electrophysiological files are stitched together and these epochs indicate the start and stop times within a recording session. These epochs are NOT continuous and there is a short interval of approx 1-5 min between them.

delay.Description: indicates whether the delay cue is on or not, from spikegadgets digital signals

behavior_epochs.Description: Indicates the start and stop times in which behavior data was both collected AND synchronized to ephys data.

thetas.Description: events identified from filtered lfp signals

ripples.Description: events identified from filtered lfp signals

nonthetas.Description: events identified from filtered lfp signals
